stories.summary: Build a deployable server image separate from the MCP-directory Dockerfile
stories.description: The root Dockerfile is the stdio MCP-directory image (Glama). A shared server needs an image that runs the dashboard and the HTTP MCP transport as a non-root user.
stories.agent_instructions:
Preflight: impact run 2026-10-28 on master cd09a83 - a stand-in of DK-01..04 together (deploy/Dockerfile with a non-root USER, deploy/entrypoint.sh, deploy/compose.yaml including a nats service, deploy/keycloak/realm.json, deploy/smoke/smoke.sh and plan.json, tests/smoke/scripted_model_server.py, .github/workflows/smoke.yml with SHA-pinned actions): 17747 passed / 21 skipped, 0 conflicts; the root Dockerfile and its tests/unit/test_dockerfile.py are untouched. The planning container has the docker client but no daemon, so `docker build`/`compose up` were not exercised - DK-04's CI job is their grade. Four other failures are environment-only and fail identically on untouched master in the planning container (test_aider_harness_availability x2: proxy-injected GH_TOKEN; test_docs_have_no_personal_home_path: the container HOME is the root user's home, which the guard bans by value; test_remote_sync ssh: no ssh binary).

TARGET IMPLEMENTER: cloud open-source (Claude-class sizing, every mechanically checkable requirement graded below). Provider/model are NOT pinned: dispatch resolves them from the live model registry's `roles.dispatch` entry.

WHAT TO BUILD: deploy/Dockerfile (leave the root Dockerfile untouched): multi-stage build on an exact `python:3.12-slim` tag, `git` installed, the app installed from requirements.txt, a non-root uid, `PLAN_DIR`/worktree root on a declared volume, an entrypoint that starts the dashboard (find how scripts/dashboard.sh / scripts/generate_systemd_units.sh launch it) and the remote MCP transport (`PIPELINE_MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http`, which refuses to start without `PIPELINE_IDENTITY_PROVIDER=oidc`), and a HEALTHCHECK on `/api/health`. No secret is baked in; the OIDC client secret arrives as a mounted file. Add deploy/README.md: build, run, required env, volumes.

TESTS: a tests/unit check that deploy/Dockerfile sets a non-root USER, pins the base tag (no `latest`), and does not COPY any `.env`/secret path; `docker build` runs in DK-04's CI job, not in unit tests.

GENERAL RULES (every step of this story):
- Write the failing tests first (CLAUDE.md Step 3) and confirm they fail on an assertion, not an import error.
- Verify with the full suite `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` AND `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check .` AND `.venv/bin/python scripts/check_line_limit.py`; all must be green before you finish. Report pass/fail counts in the PR description.
- A new test file that imports any `pipeline.*` module must `import pipeline.server` first (pre-existing import cycle). Copy the idiom in tests/unit/test_triage_cap_silent_skip.py.
- Bind a non-operator principal in tests the way tests/unit/test_patch_plan_enforcement.py does (`pipeline.actor.bind_principal`); never add an `actor` parameter to any MCP tool (a guard test forbids it).
- The harness scratchpad `.agent_scratchpad.md` stays untracked. Commit only the files this brief names plus the new test files it asks for. Add no helper scripts, dumps or module copies.
- Never modify an existing test except as this brief pre-authorizes, with the literal edit given. If another pre-existing test fails because of a change this brief requires, do NOT undo the required change - stop and report the conflict, naming the test and the requirement it contradicts.
- Comments and docs you write must stay true after later stories merge: state the invariant, never "until story X lands".
- Cumulative artifacts (the REFERENCE.md policy table, the IDENTITY_AND_POLICY.md section 4 rows, `REMOTE_*` sets): assert only what YOU add or remove (membership/absence), never the full contents, an exact count, or a hash.

stories.summary: Add a scripted model backend so an end-to-end run needs no real model

stories.summary: Compose a smoke stack: pipeline, Keycloak IdP, Caddy TLS proxy, NATS, scripted model
stories.description: One `docker compose up` that gives anyone an authenticated, TLS-fronted pipeline to smoke-test end to end.
stories.agent_instructions:

WHAT TO BUILD: deploy/compose.yaml with services `pipeline` (DK-01 image), `idp` (Keycloak in dev mode at an exact version, realm imported from deploy/keycloak/realm.json: a confidential client for the dashboard login, a client-credentials client for MCP smoke calls, two users `owner` and `stranger`), `proxy` (Caddy at an exact version, internal CA, TLS in front of pipeline :443 - the transport has no TLS of its own), `model` (DK-02 server), `nats` (nats-server at an exact version with `-js`, a creds file mounted read-only, and the pipeline set to `PIPELINE_EVENT_BUS=nats` - the scheduler daemon is the only consumer, per ADR 0010), and a `git-origin` volume holding a bare repo seeded from deploy/smoke/sample-repo. `PIPELINE_FORGE` handling: the merge loop needs GitHub or GitLab (pipeline/forge.py knows only those); the smoke run therefore stops at "reviewed, merge parked" unless a forge is configured - document it, do not fake a forge.
deploy/smoke/smoke.sh: obtain a client-credentials token; call remote MCP `list_plans` over HTTPS; ingest + approve deploy/smoke/plan.json as `owner`; dispatch one story on the scripted model; poll until reviewed; assert `stranger` is refused `approve_plan` and sees no plans; assert `verify_audit` reports intact chains; assert the 429 path after the auth-fail limit; assert a dispatch notification crossed the broker exactly once (one line in the plan's notifications log, and the JetStream consumer shows it acknowledged); restart the pipeline container mid-run and assert no notification is lost or duplicated. Exit non-zero with the failing step's name.
Use only images and versions you can name exactly; no `latest` tags.

stories.summary: Run the smoke stack in CI and publish the image as a build artifact
stories.description: Make the image and the end-to-end smoke test part of CI: build on every PR, run the compose smoke, publish to GHCR on master.
stories.agent_instructions:
